versions.scplainer: workflow in scp 1.22.0; no separate package

cohort.title: Acute exercise rewires the proteomic landscape of human immune cells
cohort.publication: Walzik et al. 2026, Nature Communications, doi:10.1038/s41467-025-68101-9
cohort.donor_map_exclusions: Author supplement includes a participant with N/A proteomics files; only donors with real proteomics files belong to the selected MS cohort
cohort.processing: Unimputed Spectronaut PG.Quantity; baseline visits only; log2; average within donor; unbiased variance across measured donor means; minimum four quantified donors per protein

alternatives.cohort: In-Depth Proteomic Characterization of Classical and Non-Classical Monocyte Subsets, 2018

alternatives.status: Excluded: proteomic assay is plasma, not primary monocytes

alternatives.cohort: Regulatory T-cell PXD022095 and MAIT PXD052574

cohort.selection_scope: Most donors among qualifying cohorts found in the documented bounded public search; not a claim of an exhaustive global maximum
cohort.transfer_assumption: Bulk PBMC variance transfers to SCP only for the same PBMC population; matching IDs alone do not establish biological transfer to cell lines. Lab pilot required; not tested by semi-synthetic M4.

versions.scplainer: workflow in scp 1.22.0; no separate package

cohort.sorted_subset_evidence: Walzik methods: unsorted PBMC pellet used for proteomics; lymphocyte subsets measured by spectral flow cytometry, stored separately on Figshare; no sorted subset protein quantities in PXD058573
cohort.composition_effect: Whole-PBMC donor variance includes differences in immune-cell composition; not a lineage-specific donor estimate.
cohort.lineage_transfer: U-937 is monocyte-like. Melanoma, PDAC and HeLa are not lymphoid cells; no matching lineage proteomics exists here. No sorted or lymphoid estimate is fabricated.

specht2019v3.transfer_assumption: Bulk donor variance transfers only to SCP of the same cell type; requires lab-pilot validation; not validated by M4.

specht2019v3.expected_intensity: Mean observed log2 protein intensity across all cells, before per-cell normalisation

compression.pilot: Include a two-proteome ratio standard to estimate k.

specht2019v3.metadata_correction: Assay-local metadata where present; otherwise exact global cell identifiers
processing: Selected peptides
Input already log2: no double-log. Source Peptides-raw.csv is cr_norm_log(t3), not raw abundance; upstream centering cannot be undone
Per-cell median of measured log2 features per protein group; all-missing remains NA
No new abundance/missingness filtering; no imputation or batch correction
Per-cell median shift only for variance; missingness uses pre-shift protein means

specht2019v3.bulk_transfer_status: Whole PBMC proxy only; no sorted-subset proteomics available. Whole-PBMC variance includes donor composition differences; lineage-specific transfer to these lines not established.
specht2019v3.flags: FLAG: fitted raw-intensity quantification slope is negative; retain the unconstrained registered fit under E and assess M2 fidelity without retuning

processing: SampleType excludes carrier, reference, blank, negative and unused channels
Pair exact cell/protein IDs to the accepted variance population; no new QC threshold
Quantified if any PSM is finite and >0; log2 positive raw intensities; per-run protein median; no normalisation
Reverse/contaminant PSM annotations excluded as non-target identities; ambiguous group IDs never invented

specht2019v3.variance_scale: Accepted ratio-based peptide-to-protein scale retained; not refitted

specht2019v3.gate_observation_scale: Missingness and coverage: raw PSM medians for TMT, quantitative protein inputs for DIA. Cell and batch SD: accepted variance assay after median shifts. Same paired cells and fixed protein universe.

engineering_checks.remote_CRAN_lookup: Disabled for the local check after a public CRAN archive timeout; hosted CI performs the full check.

missingness_equation: q(mu)=plogis(alpha + beta*(mu-center)); missingness=1-q; raw alpha=alpha-beta*center. Effective beta is zero when its Wald interval includes zero, preserving centered alpha.
variance_equation: Log2 y = cell-line fixed mean + batch random mean + residual; REML on structurally mixed batches, without donor random effects. Aliased batches excluded from batch component; no-shared-batch cell variance needs replicated cells within line/batch.
